28.text: There are, however, persons who do not wear amulets at all. Some

29.text: are forbidden by the “spirits” to avail themselves of this kind of protection.

30.text: Others abstain from following the usage on the ground of philosophical

31.text: reasoning. “I do not wear anything upon my body,” said such a person to

32.text: me, “because I am convinced that protection by such small objects must be

33.text: a mere delusion.” A shaman by the name of Scratching-Woman even went

34.text: further, and declared that all sacred things made by man are good for

35.text: nothing. He said that the fire-tool boards, strings of images, and dolls are

36.text: of no real use. “Nothing created by man has any power. On the contrary,

37.text: all power is in the deity, who created man himself and the objects of his hunt.”

38.text: Amulets are also attached to the various implements used in fishing and

39.text: hunting. Thus, wooden images of seals are fastened to a seal-net among its

40.text: floats, for the purpose of drawing to it other seals and capturing them.
